name: taipei_xinyi_v0
status: provisional v0 visual profile; global weights only, never tuned per building

provenance.band_prior.default: measured construction decade of Xinyi-area look groups matched to the building_age layer (docs/taipei-urban-visual-language-research-v0.md section 18.3), folded into three bands
provenance.band_prior.core: assumption: planned high-rise district developed from the 1980s; larger 2000+ share than the surrounding fabric. Low-rise there is genuinely ambiguous and stays mostly unknown
provenance.floor_height_likelihood: measured in this pass: floor-to-floor height of era-confirmed 2000+ groups vs groups without era evidence, outside the core, 6+ F residential (n = 209 / 1275). Walk-up / low show no signal and keep 1.0
provenance.evidence_recall: the era cache holds 2001-2025 new-build use permits; outside the core the permit-confirmed 2000+ share of 13-24 F residential groups (27 %) already matches the 25 % the age layer predicts, so absence of a permit is strong evidence against 2000+. 0.85 is deliberately below that measurement
provenance.premium: assumption: luxury-class share of new residential, highest for tall, high-ceiling towers in the planned core
